questions.question: Which statement best describes the separation at the center of a Databricks lakehouse?
options: Cloud object storage holds durable data, table and governance layers define trusted assets, and workload-specific compute executes against them
Every workload must share one continuously running Spark cluster
Unity Catalog stores all table data inside the control plane
Stopping a SQL warehouse deletes the Delta tables it queried
questions.explanation: Durable storage, table semantics and governance, and compute have separate lifecycles. That separation enables different engines and compute boundaries to work with the same governed assets.

questions.question: A versioned non-SQL job uses only features supported by serverless compute. What is the documented starting choice?
options: A classic all-purpose cluster kept running between schedules
Serverless compute for jobs
A Pro SQL warehouse
A manually attached notebook cluster
questions.explanation: Databricks recommends serverless compute for most automated workloads. Classic jobs compute is the fallback when required settings or features are unavailable in serverless.

questions.question: Why does an Auto Loader stream need a durable, unique checkpoint path?
options: It records progress and state so the query can resume consistently after restart
It replaces the source data with a backup
It grants Unity Catalog privileges to the job
It guarantees every downstream consumer is correct
questions.explanation: The checkpoint is state for one streaming query. It supports continuation and recovery, but it is not a source backup, an authorization mechanism, or a downstream correctness proof.

questions.question: A Spark stage has a 40-second median task and one 600-second task whose partition is 20 times larger than the median. What should be investigated first?
options: Driver memory, because every long task runs on the driver
Key distribution, adaptive skew handling, and the join or aggregation shape
Dashboard refresh frequency
SQL warehouse startup time
questions.explanation: One oversized partition and one extreme task tail are direct skew evidence. Inspect hot keys and the physical plan before adding generic compute.

questions.question: What must be true before a MERGE source safely updates one target row per business key?
options: The source is deduplicated so at most one intended source row matches each target key
The table has no transaction log
All readers are stopped
The job uses an all-purpose cluster
questions.explanation: A deterministic upsert needs one intended source row per target key. Deduplicate by a stable sequence or event-time rule before MERGE so repeated runs preserve the same result.

questions.question: Which Unity Catalog statement is correct?
options: USE CATALOG and USE SCHEMA alone grant SELECT on every table below them
A successful query proves every external workload is represented in lineage
Privileges and ownership govern securable objects, while fine-grained policies and workspace restrictions add other access boundaries
Production jobs should normally run as the notebook author's personal identity
questions.explanation: Unity Catalog combines object privileges and ownership with policy and workspace boundaries. Parent USE privileges are prerequisites, not automatic table-data access, and lineage has documented capture limits.
